promptText: When an owner wants a collection or soft-brand option for a hotel conversion, which brands are commonly considered globally?
rawText:
Here is a comprehensive global overview of the most commonly considered **soft brand / collection options** for hotel conversions, organized by parent company:

---

## 🏨 Marriott International


Marriott played a pivotal role in expanding the soft brand hotel concept through its **Autograph Collection**, launched in 2010.
 
Building on this success, Marriott expanded its offerings through the acquisition of Starwood Hotels and Resorts, adding other soft brands like **The Luxury Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, and **Design Hotels**.
 More recently, 
Marriott launched an outdoor-focused soft brand collection anchored by its acquisition of Postcard Cabins and a long-term agreement with Trailborn.


---

## 🏨 Hilton


Hilton embraced the soft brand concept with its **Curio Collection** and **Tapestry Collection**.
 At the luxury end, 
Hilton has **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, and in 2024, it announced a partnership with **Small Luxury Hotels of the World (SLH)**.
 
This gives Hilton Honors members new options to earn and redeem points, while SLH gains exposure on Hilton booking channels.


---

## 🏨 IHG Hotels & Resorts

IHG has a robust set of soft and conversion-friendly brands. 
IHG's soft brands include **voco Hotels** and the **Vignette Collection**, with voco aiming to reach 200 open or pipeline global properties by 2028.
 
Within two years of its August 2023 launch, the midscale conversion brand **Garner Hotels** surpassed 120 open and pipeline hotels, gaining popularity with owners thanks to its competitive conversion cost per key, flexible design standards, and reduced pre-opening costs.
 
In Q1 2025 alone, conversions accounted for around 60% of global openings and 40% of global signings for IHG.


---

## 🏨 Hyatt


Hyatt added the **Unscripted by Hyatt** brand (part of Dream Hotel Group) to its Essentials portfolio — an upscale collection brand for independent hotels, giving owners a flexible path to join the Hyatt system.
 Hyatt also offers **The Unbound Collection**, and through acquisitions has expanded with lifestyle-oriented brands like The Standard, The StandardX, and Bunkhouse Hotels. 
Hyatt's acquisition of Mr & Mrs Smith is another example of a hybrid partnership platform approach.


---

## 🏨 Wyndham Hotels & Resorts


Wyndham offers soft brand options like **Registry Collection Hotels**, **Dolce Hotels and Resorts**, and **Trademark Collection**, each tailored to owners with one-of-a-kind hotels, providing the flexibility to showcase a property's distinctive features.
 
After conversion, Wyndham provides ongoing support in marketing, revenue management, and operational efficiency, leveraging the tools and resources of a trusted global brand.


---

## 🏨 Accor

Accor is one of the most conversion-active companies globally. 
In 2025, approximately 55% of Accor's projects were conversions, with brands such as **Emblems Collection**, **MGallery Collection**, and **Handwritten Collection** leading the way, along with other conversion-ready brands including Mercure, Mövenpick, greet, TRIBE, and Hyde (from Ennismore).
 
Emblems Collection is a luxury soft brand specifically aimed at converting independent hotels.
 
MGallery Collection boasts 125+ hotels operating and 50+ in the pipeline, having grown by nearly 30% since 2022 through a balanced mix of conversions and new developments.
 
Accor now operates over 180 hotels across its collection brands worldwide, including Emblems Collection, MGallery Collection, Handwritten Collection, and Ennismore's Morgans Originals and Paris Society Hotel Collection.


---

## 🏨 Radisson Hotel Group


**Radisson Collection** is a hallmark of iconic hotels in unique locations, representing heritage and new properties across Europe, the Asia Pacific, the Middle East, and Africa.
 
**Radisson Individuals** has reached more than 100 hotels in operation and development, and recently introduced three new sub-categories — Premier, Boutique, and Retreats — to increase flexibility for owners.


---

## 🏨 Best Western & Choice Hotels


**Best Western** offers the **BW Premier Collection** and **BW Signature Collection**, while **Choice Hotels** has the **Ascend Collection** for owners seeking a soft brand affiliation.


---

## Key Takeaway


"These collections retain a specific property name, as well as a unique design and orientation toward their local community,"
 making them ideal for owners who want brand backing — including loyalty programs, distribution, and marketing support — without sacrificing their hotel's individual identity. 
As a fast and affordable alternative to new construction, hotel conversions have been a way for owners and developers to quickly grow portfolio scale.
